sources: Lyon, J. (1996) Yugoslavia's Hyperinflation 1993-1994: A Social History
notes: Peak 313 million percent in January 1994, prices doubling every 1.41 days (Hanke & Krus). Redenominations of 10:1 (Jul 1992), 1,000,000:1 (Oct 1993) and 1,000,000,000:1 (Jan 1994); the novi dinar was pegged to the Deutsche Mark on 24 January 1994. Approximate series, kept for its shape; individual points are not sourced one by one.
